title: galeopsis ladanum subsp. villosa
intro: Galeopsis ladanum subsp. villosa, commonly known as the hairy galeopsis, is a plant species that belongs to the mint family (Lamiaceae). The hairy galeopsis is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties that may aid in wound healing, reducing pain, and fighting off infections. The therapeutic actions of the hairy galeopsis include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve respiratory issues, and calm the nervous system. Bioactive constituents of the hairy galeopsis include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
